class.name: MotionBlur
class.brief_description: Real-time per-pixel camera and object motion blur using OpenGL 4.3 velocity rasterization and compute shaders.
class.description: Computes per-pixel screen-space motion vectors for camera movement (including sky), rigid [MeshInstance]s, [MultiMeshInstance]s, and animated skinned [Skeleton] meshes using raw OpenGL 4.3 rasterization and TileMax/NeighborMax compute shaders. Automatically composites a depth-aware reconstruction filter onto the active viewport before 2D UI, or exposes the velocity and neighbor-max buffers via [method get_velocity_texture] and [method get_neighbor_max_texture].

method.name: get_neighbor_max_texture
method.description: Returns the RGBA16F tile NeighborMax velocity [Texture] (RG = dilated UV velocity, A = speed in pixels).

method.name: get_velocity_texture
method.description: Returns the RGBA16F per-pixel velocity [Texture] (RG = UV velocity, B = linear view-space depth, A = speed in pixels).

method.name: reset_history
method.description: Clears stored previous-frame camera and object transforms/poses. Call this immediately after camera cuts or teleports to prevent 1-frame motion streaks.

members.member: Respects [SpatialMaterial] alpha-scissor cutouts in the velocity/depth pass.
Automatically composites motion blur onto the active viewport before 2D UI. Disable if manually sampling [method get_velocity_texture].
